title: Labour Unrest At The Ching Hwa Glass Factory

"B"
Misc. 240/41                      Pootoo Road
                                  11th September,       41
1

Labour unrest at the Ching Hwa (晶華) Glass
Factory, 1427 Gordon Road.
----------

At 11.30 a.m. 11-9-41 a telephone message was
received from the management of the above company stating
that there was labour unrest among the workers.

S.I. Zang Woo, S.I. Tsao Tse Tuh, C.D.C. 145 and the
undersigned attended when the following was ascertained.
The manager, Mr. See Zau Wo (徐肇和), had decided
to suspend the services of 33 apprentices, this action
being made necessary on account of the recent electric
power cut.

The workers had been offered 3 months pay by the
manager, but they refused same demanding that they should
receive 5 months pay, however, the management refused
their demands whereupon the apprentices stated that they
would not leave the factory until their demands were
heeded.

However, through the mediation of the Police, the 33
apprentices accepted the management's terms and were at
3 p.m. 11-9-41 paid off without creating further trouble.

S. D. informed.

Copies to
Sp. Br. (Direct)
Miss Hinder (Direct)

D.S.D. ops          Sen. Det. 1/9. [Signature]

W. I. Stg.
D. C. B.

DATE 12/9/41

戈登路1427号晶华玻璃厂的劳工骚动。
----------

1941年9月11日上午11时30分，接到上述公司管理层打来的电话，称工人中存在劳工骚动。

警佐臧武（Zang Woo）、警佐曹泽土（Tsao Tse Tuh）、中央捕房145号及本人前往现场，查明情况如下。经理徐肇和（See Zau Wo）先生决定停止33名学徒的工作，此举是因近期电力中断而不得不采取的措施。

经理已向工人提供3个月的工资，但工人拒绝接受，要求支付5个月的工资；然而，管理层拒绝了他们的要求，于是学徒们表示，在他们的要求得到满足之前，他们不会离开工厂。

然而，经警方调解，这33名学徒接受了管理层的条件，并于1941年9月11日下午3时结清工资离职，未再引发进一步事端。

已通知特别处。

抄送：
特别处（直送）
辛德女士（Miss Hinder）（直送）
